head_commit.message:
Sign the PowerShell installer in Windows releases (#51158)

## What changed

Extend the Windows signing action with an `additional-files` input and sign `scripts/install/install.ps1` with Azure Trusted Signing in the x64 release job. Stage the architecture-independent installer after compression so it remains a plain script, and publish the signed artifact as `install.ps1` instead of copying the unsigned source.

## Testing

The Windows release workflow verifies that the installer has a valid Authenticode signature and a timestamp certificate before staging it, failing the job if either check fails.
